en.name: Instant breakfast drinks, bottled
en.summary: A sealed bottle of ready-to-drink instant breakfast keeps 6 months in the cupboard. It is a low-acid milk-based drink held safe by heat processing and an intact seal — once that seal is broken it becomes a refrigerated food with a very short life.
en.pantry: Unopened, in a cool, dry, dark cupboard, 6 months. The drink inside is essentially sterilised milk with added protein, sugar and vitamins, and it sits on a shelf for the same reason a can of coconut milk does: the heat process and the seal, not the ingredients. Warmth is the enemy of quality here — bottles stored above a fridge or next to the hob go from creamy to cardboardy and the vitamins degrade — and a bottle that is swollen, leaking, or that fizzes or smells sour on opening goes in the bin without tasting.
en.fridge: The bottle does not need the fridge until it is opened, though chilling it before serving obviously helps. Once opened, it is a perishable dairy drink: cap it, refrigerate at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and finish it within a day or so — no separate published timeline exists for the opened bottle, so err short. Never drink straight from the bottle and then keep the rest; mouth bacteria go in with every sip and a milk drink is an excellent place for them. Do not let an opened bottle stand out of the fridge for more than two hours, or one hour above 32 °C (90 °F).
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published for bottled breakfast drinks, and freezing them is not recommended. A milk-protein emulsion separates when it freezes and thaws grainy and watery, and a full sealed bottle can split as the liquid expands. If you have surplus you cannot drink, it is better to use it in baking or a smoothie within the fridge window than to freeze it.
spoilage: A swollen or leaking bottle, or a cap that pops with pressure.
Sour, yeasty or off smell on opening.
Lumps, curdling or stringy texture when poured.
Any colour change from creamy to grey, pink or yellow.
tips: Pour into a glass instead of drinking from the bottle if you plan to keep the rest.
Store cases away from heat sources; warmth costs flavour and vitamins.
Rotate stock so the oldest bottle is always the next one out.
Discard a swollen or fizzing bottle without tasting it.

faq.q: How long do bottled breakfast drinks last?
faq.a: 6 months unopened in a cool dry cupboard. Once opened, refrigerate and finish within a day or so.

faq.q: Do they need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: Not while sealed. After opening they are a perishable milk drink and must be refrigerated at 4 °C (40 °F) or below.
It is not recommended. The emulsion separates and thaws grainy, and a full bottle can split as the liquid expands.

zh.name: 即飲早餐飲品
zh.summary: 未開封的瓶裝即飲早餐飲品放櫥櫃可放 6 個月。它是低酸性的乳製飲品，靠加熱殺菌與完好的密封維持安全；封口一破，它就變成保存期很短的冷藏食品。
zh.pantry: 未開封放陰涼、乾燥、避光的櫥櫃，6 個月。瓶子裡基本上是滅菌過的牛奶，再加上蛋白質、糖與維生素；它之所以能放在架上，理由和椰奶罐頭一樣，是加熱製程與密封，而不是配方本身。這裡溫度是品質的頭號敵人——放在冰箱上方或爐台旁的瓶子，會從奶香變成紙板味，維生素也會衰減。瓶身鼓脹、滲漏，或開瓶時冒氣、發酸的，不要試喝，直接丟掉。
zh.fridge: 未開封時不需要冷藏，當然喝之前冰過會比較好喝。一旦開封，它就是易腐的乳製飲品：蓋好、放 4 °C 以下冷藏，並在一天左右喝完——開封後並沒有另外公布的期限，所以請往短的估。也不要直接對嘴喝完再留著，每一口都會把口腔的細菌帶進去，而牛奶飲品正是它們最喜歡的環境。開封後的瓶子離開冰箱不要超過兩小時，氣溫超過 32 °C 時不要超過一小時。
zh.freezer: 瓶裝早餐飲品沒有公布的冷凍期限，也不建議冷凍。乳蛋白乳化物一結冰就會分離，解凍後又粗又水；裝滿的密封瓶還可能因為液體膨脹而裂開。如果有喝不完的量，在冷藏期限內拿去烘焙或打成果昔，比冷凍實際得多。
spoilage: 瓶身鼓脹、滲漏，或開蓋時有壓力衝出。
開瓶就聞到酸味、酵母味或怪味。
倒出來有結塊、凝乳或牽絲。
顏色從乳白變灰、變粉紅或泛黃。
tips: 打算留下剩的就倒進杯子喝，不要對嘴。
整箱不要放在熱源旁，溫度會吃掉風味與維生素。
先進先出，永遠先喝最舊的那瓶。
鼓脹或冒氣的瓶子不要嚐，直接丟。

faq.q: 瓶裝早餐飲品可以放多久？
faq.a: 未開封放陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃 6 個月。開封後要冷藏，並在一天左右喝完。
未開封不用。開封後它是易腐的乳品飲料，必須放 4 °C 以下冷藏。
不建議。乳化會分離、解凍後口感粗糙，裝滿的瓶子也可能因膨脹而裂開。
